1.w: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered, and said:

2.w: “Shall a multitude of words not be answered? And should a man of lips be justified?

3.w: Shall your idle boasts cause men to be silent? And will you mock, and no one is ashamed?

4.w: For you have said, ‘My doctrine [is] pure, and I am clean in Your eyes.’

5.w: But who will give God to speak, and open His lips against you,

6.w: and declare to you the secrets of wisdom—for [there are] two sides to wisdom. And know that God forgets some of your iniquity.

7.w: Can you find out the searching of God? Or can you find out unto the limit of Shaddai?

8.w: The heights of the heavens—what can you do? [They are] deeper than Sheol—what can you know?

9.w: Longer than the earth [is] its measure, and wider than the sea.

10.w: If He passes by and imprisons and assembles, then who can turn Him back?

11.w: For He knows the men of vanity, and He sees iniquity—[will] He not then discern [it]?

12.w: But a man [who is] hollow will become wise when the colt of a wild donkey is born [as] a man!

13.w: If you would prepare your heart, and stretch out your hands to Him,

14.w: if iniquity is in your hand, put it far away, and do not let injustice dwell in your tents.

15.w: Surely then you could lift up your face without blemish, and you could be established and not fear.

16.w: For you would forget [your] toil, [and] remember [it] as waters pass by.

17.w: And more than noon life will arise; darkness will become like the morning.

18.w: And you will be secure, because there is hope, and you will search [and] lie down in safety.

19.w: Then You will lie down, and there will be no one making [you] tremble, and many will seek favor [from] your face.

20.w: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will perish from them, and their hope [be] a puff of the soul.”
